text:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — new rate-sheet import pushed this morning (sheet id: rs_2026_03_23). We're seeing invoices for a subset of PAYG customers charged ~100x. Example in #invoice-recon. Any ideas? :eyes:

Tom Nguyen: looking now. Do you have sample CSV/ingest payload? can you paste a row?

Aisha Patel: pasted sample below
```csv
customer_id,plan_id,price_cents,effective_date
cus_12,plan_pro,10000,2026-03-23
```
But actual applied row in invoices shows 1000000 cents. (see invoice inv_9876)

Ruth Chen: if it's systematic we should pause the rollout and stop the batch job. Can someone flip the pricing-apply feature flag?

Mike L: Impacted customers list looks like cohort 'trial-pro' in EU region. ~42 invoices so far. Halting now.

Tom Nguyen: quick check in the ingest lambda — mapping expects 'price_cents' but our parser read 'pricecents' (no underscore) due to vendor's sheet. Patch candidate: add tolerant parser that accepts both keys. Logs:
```
KeyError: 'price_cents'
source_row: {'customer_id':'cus_12','plan_id':'plan_pro','pricecents':'10000',...}
```

Jen S: we should also revert the poor rows in billing DB. I can run a targeted fix if we get a list of invoice ids. Also need sign-off from RevOps for credit memos.

Ruth Chen: approved for emergency credits up to $5k. Please tag me on the adjustment PR.

Tom Nguyen: deploying quick patch to parser now — will add migration that normalizes pricecents -> price_cents. Deploying to staging, then prod if green. ETA 12m.

billing-bot: job pricing-apply-prod paused by Mike L at 2026-03-23T11:47Z

Aisha Patel: uploaded list of impacted invoices: inv_9876, inv_9880, inv_9891, inv_9902, inv_9910 (attached). Jen, assigning to you. Tom, ping when patch live.

Tom Nguyen: patch live in prod. Rolling back bad rows where price > 1e6 cents in last 6h as temporary hold. Command used:
```bash
db run-sql "UPDATE invoices SET amount_cents=amount_cents/100 WHERE amount_cents>1000000 AND source='rate_ingest' AND created_at > now() - interval '6 hours'"
```
Monitoring... :mag:

Jen S: starting credit memos generation for listed invoices. Will post PR for adjustments (will include customer notifications).

Aisha Patel: thanks all. After 24h we'll run reconciliation to confirm no residual effects. Postmortem please — label: pricing-ingest-mismatch. :white_check_mark:
